profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer III at Nike
profile.summary:
I am an energetic and creative engineer with passion for learning and problem-solving. I strive for effectiveness and efficiency in both my personal and professional life. I love learning new things from systems management to development of new technology to even cooking a great meal at home. I have had first hand customer support experience as a help desk technician and experience with more technical customers in my roles as system administrator of various operating systems.
 
My main goal is to gain a greater understanding of the lower levels of abstraction of the technologies that we all use today and have a great time doing so.

positions.title: System Administrator(Linux)
positions.description: Manage RHEL Linux operating system and work with developers to make sure that Travelport products are working correctly.

positions.title: Systems Administrator (Windows)
positions.description: Managed windows servers for commercial operations. I also used SCOM 2007 and powershell to help accomplish tasks efficiently.

positions.title: Help Desk Supervisor
positions.description: Managed network, servers, databases, and workstations. Worked with customers and fellow employees to ensure smooth operation of technical business functions.
